title: Question Explorer
intro: Fifty questions in ten sections — the launch set for this app. Every question opens the curated article that answers it, and every article can be listened to in the selected language or followed up with the AI guide.
editorialNote: Each question is mapped to a knowledge-base document and, where useful, to a refined phrasing that retrieves better from the guide. Questions that need a person rather than an app (vows, family rites, personal religious decisions) point to the app's guidance boundary instead of pretending to decide for the reader.

sections.title: Puja and Daily Rituals

sections.intro: Mantra, stotra, chalisa and aarti — what they are and how to approach them.

sections.title: Fasting, Food and Well-being

sections.intro: Durga Puja, garba, Dasara, golu, and the observances across India and Nepal.
